title: The Secrets of the Temple of Heaven
synopsis: Unveil the secrets of Beijing’s sacrificial temple and understand the significance of its location and architecture

fullText.simplified:
天坛的秘密

    天坛是中国现存最大的祭祀建筑群，是中国的5A级旅游景区。除了这些以外，天坛还有很多神奇的秘密。今天就给大家介绍其中的两个。
    一、天坛为什么没有建在北京的正中心？
    众所周知，故宫在北京的正中心，天坛作为重要的祭祀场所，理所应当也在正中心，但是天坛却选在了南边。其实这与太阳的位置有关，当时的人们认为东南方向是太阳光线最充足的方位，是祭祀的最佳地点。因此，天坛就没有被建在北京正中间。
    二、皇帝祭祀的时候为什么住在西边的房子？
    大家都知道皇帝一直住在皇宫最重要的位置。但是到了天坛，他却住在了西边一个位置很偏僻的地方。这个原因其实很简单：天坛是祭天的场所，天最大，皇帝只能排第二。天坐北朝南，皇帝只能坐西朝东了。
    关于天坛，还有很多有趣的事情等着喜欢中国文化和历史的你去发现。感兴趣的话，你可以亲自来北京看一看！
fullText.traditional:
天壇的秘密

    天壇是中國現存最大的祭祀建築群，是中國的5A級旅遊景區。除了這些以外，天壇還有很多神奇的秘密。今天就給大家介紹其中的兩個。
    一、天壇為什麼沒有建在北京的正中心？
    眾所周知，故宮在北京的正中心，天壇作為重要的祭祀場所，理所應當也在正中心，但是天壇卻選在了南邊。其實這與太陽的位置有關，當時的人們認為東南方向是太陽光線最充足的方位，是祭祀的最佳地點。因此，天壇就沒有被建在北京正中間。
    二、皇帝祭祀的時候為什麼住在西邊的房子？
    大家都知道皇帝一直住在皇宮最重要的位置。但是到了天壇，他卻住在了西邊一個位置很偏僻的地方。這個原因其實很簡單：天壇是祭天的場所，天最大，皇帝只能排第二。天坐北朝南，皇帝只能坐西朝東了。
    關於天壇，還有很多有趣的事情等著喜歡中國文化和歷史的你去發現。感興趣的話，你可以親自來北京看一看！

raw.synopsis: Unveil the secrets of Beijing’s sacrificial temple and understand the significance of its location and architecture
sentence_translations: The Secrets of the Temple of Heaven
The Temple of Heaven is China’s largest surviving sacrificial building complex and is a national 5A scenic area.
As well as this, the Temple of Heaven also has many mysterious secrets.
Today we will introduce two of them to you.
First, why wasn’t the Temple of Heaven built in the center of Beijing?
Everyone knows that the Forbidden City lies in the center of Beijing.
As an important place for offering sacrifices, ..
.. the Temple of Heaven should naturally also be located in the center of the city.
However, it was decided to locate the Temple of Heaven to the south.
In fact, this was related to the position of the sun.
People at the time thought that the southeast direction was where sunlight was most abundant, ..
.. and the best place for offering sacrifices.
Therefore, the Temple of Heaven was not built in the center of Beijing.
Second, when the emperor came to offer sacrifices, why did he stay in a house on the west side?
Everyone knows that the emperor always lived in the most important place in the imperial palace.
But when he came to the Temple of Heaven, he stayed in a house located far away on the west side.
The reason for this is actually very simple: the Temple of Heaven was a place for worshiping Heaven.
Heaven was the most important, and the emperor could only rank in second place.
Heaven was in the north facing south, therefore the emperor could only stay in the west facing east.
Regarding the Temple of Heaven, ..
.. there are many other things waiting for you, as someone who likes Chinese culture and history, to discover.
If you are interested, you can come to Beijing and take a look for yourself!
